author: Tempus
body:
Welcome to Orbis, a city that actually is kinda floating on a circle in the sky.
 
No, but seriously
Orbis is a map I've been working on for a little while, and not without a lot of stress.
There have been 5 or 6 crashes just while working on it in singleplayer, after Steven's Server shut down.
It's actually been fun, and now it's time for me to release it into the wild.
---------
Hotfix vReleaseA
- Building Has 3 types of bricks - Mossy Cobble, Cracked Stone Bricks and Regular stone Bricks.
- Road alternates between grey (gray) and black wool, with stripe down the middle.
- Spawns are all the same, no difference. (You better thank me for that. It took me SO LONG to copy/paste it w/ world edit)
- Forests are hard to get in but it is possible. ATM, there is 1 very very hard way to get out, tell me if I should add more or fix that. :)
Download link : https://www.mediafire.com/?dprq1r30h5os427
Album link : http://imgur.com/a/EfI2A  
 
 
 Guys, I did repost this from the Map Releases, so hopefully it gets more views here.
